title: Cocktail Party Board
seo_title: Cocktail Party Charcuterie Board for 12–20: Shopping List & Plan
description: An elegant cocktail party board for 12–20: Gruyère, Manchego, triple-crème, Gorgonzola dolce, prosciutto, bresaola, Champagne grapes and dark chocolate.
hook: Small bites for people holding a drink in one hand. Every piece is one-bite sized, and every flavour is picked to stand up to spirits.
why: Cocktails are strong, so the food has to be too. Salty Manchego and nutty Gruyère stand up to whiskey and gin, the triple-crème softens a bitter drink, and Gorgonzola with truffle honey holds its own against anything stirred.

Everything is sized for one bite and one free hand: folded prosciutto, small crostini, olives without pits. Dark chocolate and dried apricots cover the sweet side for the dessert drinkers, and cornichons and Dijon keep the meats sharp.

timeline.what: Take all the cheeses out of the fridge.
Drain the olives and cornichons; fill the small bowls.
Place the cheeses; set out the honey and mustard.
Drape the meats; add fruit and crackers.

faq.q: How many people does this cocktail party board serve?
faq.a: 12 to 20 people over a two-hour cocktail party, on an 18–22 inch board.
Firm, salty cheeses like Manchego and Gruyère for spirit-forward drinks; a triple-crème for bitter ones like a Negroni.

faq.q: How do I make everything one-bite?
faq.a: Cut the cheese into small triangles, fold the meats in quarters and use crostini instead of a whole baguette.
